scope_note: Round 1 (mission 18376, docs/XVAL-LBM-SPARSE-LIST-BASED-AOS-LBM.md) validated the 2-D D2Q9 list-based AoS port against lbmpy.sparse and analytic Poiseuille/Taylor-Green. Round 2 attacks the two gaps left open: (i) the port was D2Q9-only although TensorLBM's production stencil is D3Q19, (ii) the solid semantics were only exercised by wall planes at the domain border, never by solid cells *inside* the fluid list. Nothing from round 1 is re-implemented; round 1 artefacts stay untouched and are cited as the 2-D baseline.
deliverables: src/tensorlbm/sparse_list_aos.py: dimension-generic (D2Q9/D3Q19) weights, equilibrium, Guo collision, macroscopic values, dense control arm, SparseListLBM state

oss.feature: sparse list-based pdf storage, pull-through-index-array streaming, no-slip by index aliasing
anchor_facts: mapping.py:103-160 create_index_array builds (N_fluid, Q-1) uint32 pull offsets for ANY dimension (dim taken from len(flag_arr.shape), coordinate struct x/y/z) - so the generator itself is 3-D capable and can be executed in-process for D3Q19

mapping.py:118-122 pdf_index(cell,d) = cell + d*len(self) is hardcoded SoA, with an explicit '# TODO support different layouts here' - the OSS index array is SoA-only while the pdf list can be AoS (update_rule_sparse.py:8-20, layout='AoS'|'SoA'), i.e. the layout pair is unguarded in the OSS
mapping.py:130-135 no-slip by aliasing to inverse_idx(own cell) is tested BEFORE the periodic wrap
mapping.py:136-148 periodic wrap across ghost layers: x_i == ghost-1 -> += n-2*ghost ; x_i == n-ghost -> -= n-2*ghost
stencil tables: lbmpy.stencils.LBStencil('D3Q19') (19 directions, y-first/z-last ordering) - used verbatim as C_D3Q19_LBMPY

external_anchor.duct_series: F. M. White, Viscous Fluid Flow, 3rd ed., Sec. 3-3.3 (rectangular-duct Fourier series); reproduced in the code comment of duct_poiseuille_analytic
external_anchor.shear_wave: exact Navier-Stokes solution u = A sin(k z) exp(-nu k^2 t): divergence-free and nonlinearity-free, so the analytic decay rate is exact, not a linearisation
external_anchor.guo_forcing: Guo, Zheng & Shi, Phys. Rev. E 65, 046308 (2002)
external_anchor.tannehill: Tannehill, Anderson & Pletcher, Computational Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer, 2nd ed., Sec. 9 (shear-wave decay rate nu k^2)

hypothesis.H1: The D2Q9 port generalises to D3Q19 without changing the storage/traversal semantics: the 3-D index array generated by TensorLBM equals lbmpy.sparse.SparseLbMapper.create_index_array element-by-element, and the list traversal equals an independent dense D3Q19 traversal step-by-step.
hypothesis.H2: The D3Q19 list solver reproduces the analytic references (plane Poiseuille, rectangular duct, shear-wave decay, periodic interior-slab channel) within the owner 15% band.
hypothesis.H3: Solid cells *inside* the list (not border walls) are handled correctly by the no-slip aliasing: a periodic array of interior solid slabs reproduces the exact channel Poiseuille profile, and mass is conserved.
hypothesis.H4: Mixing the OSS (SoA) index array with the AoS pdf layout is silently wrong and therefore must be rejected/detected, not trusted.

metrics.physics_error: max_y |u_got(y) - u_ref(y)| / max_y u_ref  (and L2 relative)
metrics.arm_equivalence: max|u_armA - u_armB| / u_max over all fluid cells
metrics.decay_rate: |omega_got - omega_ref| / omega_ref, omega from a 2-e-folding log fit of the sine-mode amplitude
metrics.memory: bytes of the pdf (+index/coords) for dense vs sparse at equal geometry
metrics.throughput: wall seconds per step on one core, same geometry/step count

thresholds.layout_mismatch_control: must exceed 1e-6 or be non-finite (i.e. detectable, not silent)
thresholds.grid_convergence: error must decrease with resolution for the two finest grids of every refinement study

stopping_rules: Plane Poiseuille / duct / interior-slab cases: iterate until max|du|/u_max < 1e-10 or 200000 steps; report the step count actually used.
Shear wave: fixed window of two e-foldings (t = 0 .. 2/(nu k^2)), sampled at 5 equally spaced times.
Any case that exceeds its step cap is reported as NOT converged with the achieved drift, never as passed.
Abort the whole run if the OSS index-array comparison fails (the port would be meaningless).

changed: lattice (D3Q19 vs the round-1 D2Q9 baseline)
storage layout (dense / list-SoA / list-AoS) at identical discrete scheme
solid fraction and solid topology (border walls vs interior slabs)

environment.lbmpy: 2.0 installed wheel (used only as the OSS reference for the index array; all solver kernels are TensorLBM code)
environment.compute: local (single core, < 10 min per the compute gate) unless a case is escalated to the cluster queue
